tools.name: move_note_to_notebook
tools.description: Moves a note's Markdown file from its current notebook folder into another notebook folder in the vault. It also updates the note's notebook field in the front matter and its path in the vault index so links keep resolving.

params.name: note_path
params.description: Path of the note relative to the vault root, e.g. 'inbox/meeting-2026-11-02.md'.

params.name: target_notebook
params.description: Name of the destination notebook folder, e.g. 'projects/atlas'.

tools.name: get_note_with_backlinks
tools.description: Looks up a note in the knowledge base by its slug and returns its title, tags, body, and the list of notes that link to it.
tools.code:
import sqlite3

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("knowledge-base")
DB_PATH = "/var/lib/kb/notes.sqlite"


@mcp.tool()
def get_note_with_backlinks(slug: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB_PATH}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    note = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, slug, title, body, updated_at FROM notes WHERE slug = ?", (slug,)
    ).fetchone()
    if note is None:
        conn.close()
        return {"found": False, "slug": slug}
    tags = [r["name"] for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT t.name FROM tags t JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.tag_id = t.id WHERE nt.note_id = ? ORDER BY t.name",
        (note["id"],),
    )]
    backlinks = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT n.slug, n.title FROM links l JOIN notes n ON n.id = l.source_id WHERE l.target_id = ? ORDER BY n.title",
        (note["id"],),
    )]
    conn.close()
    return {
        "found": True,
        "slug": note["slug"],
        "title": note["title"],
        "updated_at": note["updated_at"],
        "tags": tags,
        "body": note["body"],
        "backlinks": backlinks,
    }

tools.name: purge_orphaned_attachments
tools.description: Runs the vault-lint scanner to find attachment files (images, PDFs, audio) that no note references anymore, then permanently deletes those files from the vault's attachments folder. Use dry_run to only list them without deleting.

params.name: vault_dir
params.description: Absolute path to the notes vault root.

params.name: dry_run
params.description: If true, report orphaned attachments without deleting them.

tools.name: email_note_to_recipients
tools.description: Emails a note's title and Markdown body to one or more recipients through the team's SMTP server, with an optional personal message above the note.

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the note, used as the email subject.

params.name: message
params.description: Optional short message to include before the note content.

tools.code:
import os import smtplib from email.message import EmailMessage from email.utils import make_msgid, formatdate import markdown SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("NOTES_SMTP_HOST", "smtp.internal") SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("NOTES_SMTP_PORT", "587")) SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("NOTES_SMTP_USER", "") SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("NOTES_SMTP_PASSWORD", "") FROM_ADDRESS = os.environ.get("NOTES_FROM_ADDRESS", "notes-bot@localhost") MAX_RECIPIENTS = 25 def email_note_to_recipients(title: str, body_markdown: str, recipients: list, message: str = "") -> dict: cleaned = sorted({r.strip() for r in recipients if isinstance(r, str) and "@" in r}) if not cleaned: return {"ok": False, "error": "No valid recipient addresses"} if len(cleaned) > MAX_RECIPIENTS: return {"ok": False, "error": f"Too many recipients (max {MAX_RECIPIENTS})"} intro = f"{message.strip()}\n\n---\n\n" if message else "" plain = f"{intro}# {title}\n\n{body_markdown}" html_intro = f"

{message.strip()}

" if message else "" html = f"{html_intro}

{title}

{markdown.markdown(body_markdown, extensions=['fenced_code', 'tables'])}" msg = EmailMessage() msg["Subject"] = f"Shared note: {title}" msg["From"] = FROM_ADDRESS msg["To"] = ", ".join(cleaned) msg["Date"] = formatdate(localtime=True) msg["Message-ID"] = make_msgid(domain=FROM_ADDRESS.split("@")[-1]) msg.set_content(plain) msg.add_alternative(html, subtype="html") try: with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=30) as smtp: smtp.starttls() if SMTP_USER: smtp.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD) refused = smtp.send_message(msg) except (smtplib.SMTPException, OSError) as exc: return {"ok": False, "error": str(exc)} return { "ok": True, "message_id": msg["Message-ID"], "delivered_to": [r for r in cleaned if r not in refused], "refused": list(refused.keys()), }
